condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: IWF received group information from primary MC GMS
claims.conclusion: IWF subscribes to primary MC GMS; response reports success/failure.

conditions: MC GMS received group information from IWF
claims.conclusion: MC GMS subscribes to IWF; response reports success/failure.

conditions: MC GMS received/stored new configuration, or IWF has new group information, respectively
claims.conclusion: Provider notifies subscriber; receiver reports success/failure.

limitations: No timers, resubscription, delivery guarantees or wire encoding.
